_note: PAPER ONLY desk config. starting_bankroll_usd is the ONE bankroll value: reset_paper_book.py starts the main paper book with it, and experiment sub-books (scoring/weights.json experiments.*.start_usd = null) inherit it. Allowed range $250-500 (default $250); reset_paper_book.py refuses anything else. The owner picks the value at setup. Changing it does not touch a running book: run reset_paper_book.py (it archives the old book first, or creates the first book if none exists).
